level1.title: A Boy Shares His Lunch
level1.story: A big crowd was hungry. A boy shared five loaves and two fish. Jesus gave thanks, and there was enough for everyone!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
level1.prayer: Jesus, I give You what I have. Amen.

activity.title: Jesus gave thanks
activity.intro: Jesus gave thanks before the meal. Check each time you pray grace.

level2.title: Five Loaves and Two Fish
level2.story: A great multitude followed Jesus, and He asked Philip, "Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?" Andrew said, "There is a boy here that hath five barley loaves, and two fishes; but what are these among so many?" Jesus had the people sit down, about five thousand men. He took the loaves, gave thanks, and distributed them, and the fish too, as much as they wanted. They gathered twelve baskets of leftover fragments.
level2.keyLine: Jesus took the loaves: and when he had given thanks, he distributed.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How is this sign like the Eucharist?
level2.prayer: Jesus, take my little and make it much. Amen.
